title: Salinas (London) and Ronquillo (Nijmegen) to Fuenmayor, 1676-78, DECODE R966-R984, R1001

steps.what: Applied the Balbases key to all 20 remaining SEG 2559 cipher records.
Six records typed with no group boundaries read 0%; rejoined and segmented by DP over the key vocabulary.
Mapped DECODE's 'Infinity' sign in R970/R973 to c+vowel.
Key output agrees with the 16 marginal decipherments; four unmargined letters read in gist.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): DECODE's transcriptions copied into decode/ (from the git-ignored img/) and the key output read/R*.txt, one entry per letter (20)

Reading audit (George Lasry's sentence test, 22 Oct 2026): read/R*.txt read through, best (R971 93.6%, R974, R978, R979, R1001) and worst (R970, R976, R982). Every letter is unspaced decoder output with bracketed groups every few words; even the best can be built into sentences only with guesswork (0-72% of sentences clean in docs/_check_reading.py). All twenty relabelled decoded, not read; class read in part -> not read, method -> not solved, key stays recovered; fraction_read 0.883 -> 0.

outcome.method_basis: All twenty letters in Fuenmayor's volume (AGR SEG 2559) were read unchanged with the Balbases 1677 key, which the project had rebuilt earlier for other letters in the same volume; sixteen carry contemporary marginal decipherments that agree with the output. Reading audit, 22 Oct 2026: none of the twenty decryptions is built into sentences (unspaced output from DECODE's uncorrected transcriptions, holes every few words), so the letters are decoded, not read and the method is 'not solved' until they are.
outcome.fraction_read_source: 22 Oct 2026, reading audit: no letter builds sentences yet, so 0 of 23,463 groups are in text that reads. Withdrawn as a reading figure: 0.883 (read/R*.txt headers, read.py with the Balbases key: 20,727 of 23,463 groups given a value; unmargined R970 77%, R973 86%, R982 71%, R984 86%).
outcome.notes: 22 Oct 2026, reading audit: all twenty letters relabelled decoded, not read; the key (Balbases 1677) is recovered and gives 0.88 of the groups a value, but no letter is built into sentences. Earlier: read in part under the read bar, the four unmargined letters read only for gist.

gaps.item: all twenty letters decoded, not read
gaps.detail: space and build each decode into sentences, using the contemporary margin decipherments of the sixteen margined letters (re-read from the images, not DECODE's transcription) and re-transcribing the worst groups; then translate

gaps.item: R970, R973, R982, R984 (unmargined letters) unread groups: R970 23%, R973 14%, R982 29%, R984 14%
gaps.detail: residue is DECODE transcription noise ('?', '*', split groups); the images were not re-transcribed, so these four are read only for gist

gaps.item: ~12% of groups across the sixteen margined letters
gaps.detail: transcription noise; margins give the sense, images not re-read

credits.note: marginal decipherments on 16 of the 20 letters, which confirm the key output
